title: Southern-Style Roasted Chicken
description: A classic Southern dish featuring roasted chicken, rice, and a hint of Thai spices. This recipe is perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish.
Add guanciale, onion, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Pour the curry sauce over the chicken in the baking dish.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Serve the roasted chicken with cooked rice and spoon some of the curry sauce over the top.
